$comment: VAPP-191 (eApps Q2): the expression language (catalog/expressions.json `$comment` = the spec; src/expressions.ts the reference, the Rust core's `expressions` module its twin, Swift and Kotlin through the FFI). GENERATED expected values (`bun run --filter @exponential_app/eui generate`, scripts/generate-host.ts); the inputs are hand-written. The constants (`limits`, `functions`, `methods`, `comprehensions`, `reserved`, `rowKeys`) are copied from the catalog and every twin's tables must equal them. `clock` = the default clock (`now` ISO, `offsetMinutes` = the team zone's fixed UTC offset), `vars` = the default variables (a case's own `vars` REPLACE them), `kinds` = the record kinds every `checkCases` entry checks against. evalCases + costCases: evalExpression(source, vars, clock) → {value} | {error}. checkCases: checkExpression(source, types, kinds) → {type, issues}. callCases: the A2UI call form callExpressionFunction(call, args, clock) → {value}, or {} when the call yields nothing (undefined).
